messages:
ana: Heads-up from sales: FinNova requires per-tenant retention tiers + BYOK + regional residency for pilot next month. Need quick scope and launch criteria.
sam: clarify retention windows? searchable vs export-only?
ana: searchable 60d, quick-export to 1y, long-term export to 3y.
jordy: ops notes: we need a legal-hold flag, an admin export API, and an evidence manifest. BYOK means we must support an escrow handshake and documented rotation steps.
rahul: rough infra delta: 60d warm index ~ $4k/mo for 2TB, cold pipeline ~ $2k/mo, ops overhead ~$700/mo. dev effort ~1-2 eng-weeks for export endpoints + BYOK test harness.
ana: proposed acceptance criteria: per-tenant retention selector (60/365/3y), admin export API + manifest, legal-hold toggle, BYOK handshake docs + test harness, regional-residency tag.
sam: SLA proposal: 60d search 99.5% <20s; quick-export (<=1y) restore <6h; cold export (<3y) 24-72h.
jordy: decision: make retention tiers enterprise-only for pilot. Self-serve later.
ops-bot: Action: file SOC2 control mapping and attach to the pilot ticket.
ana: I'll write a short PRD and add cost numbers to the shared sheet. Please flag blockers by EOD.
